meta.parties: Shariffa Umma Et Al. v. Rahamathu Umma

rules.statement: A Muhammadan in Ceylon can dispose of the whole of his property by will under Ordinance No. 21 of 1844, section 1.
rules.supporting_quote: "This provision has uniformly been construed to enable Muhammadans in Ceylon to dispose of the whole of their property by will, and the Muhammadan population in Ceylon has freely taken advantage of the privilege."
